# Elektricien Bas

> Certified electrician based in Elsrijk, Amstelveen (Netherlands), serving Amstelveen, Amsterdam, Aalsmeer, Haarlem and Almere. Homes and businesses. 24/7 emergency service. Dutch and English spoken. NEN 1010, NEN 3140 and SCIOS certified; business inspections through Keuring Service Nederland. Rated 4.8/5 from 36 Google reviews.

## Services
- [Power faults and short circuits, 24/7](https://elektricien-bas.vercel.app/storing-elektricien-24-7/): tracing and repairing faults, tripping RCDs, outages in homes and businesses
- [Fuse box replacement](https://elektricien-bas.vercel.app/groepenkast-vervangen/): new fuse boxes (groepenkast), extra circuits, earthing, 3-phase connections for solar panels and EV chargers
- [EV charger installation](https://elektricien-bas.vercel.app/laadpaal-installeren-amstelveen/): home and business chargers, including a check of the fuse box and connection
- [LED lighting](https://elektricien-bas.vercel.app/led-verlichting/): stair lighting, ambient and indoor/outdoor lighting, dimmers, sensors, smart lighting
- [Electrical inspections for businesses](https://elektricien-bas.vercel.app/elektra-keuring-bedrijven/): SCIOS and NEN 3140 inspections for restaurants, shops and offices, with an inspection report
- Security: CCTV cameras, video intercoms, smart doorbells
- [English-speaking electrician](https://elektricien-bas.vercel.app/english-speaking-electrician-amsterdam/): quotes and communication in English for expats

## Certifications
- NEN 1010 (safe installation of electrical systems)
- NEN 3140 (safe operation, maintenance and inspection)
- SCIOS (inspection scheme often required by insurers)
- Keuring Service Nederland (business inspections)
